observations: Photo 0 shows a single LPG gas cylinder with an orange/red body and black plastic collar/handle guard on top.
Printed icons on the body show a house, a cup, and a chef's hat, typical of cooking-gas branding.
A small logo is visible near the top of the black collar but the text is too small/blurred to read reliably.
No visible capacity (kg) marking, no visible manufacture or re-test/expiry date stamp, and the valve itself is not clearly shown.
Cylinder is sitting on a tiled surface, no scale, no flame test, no regulator attached in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a logo near the top collar but it is too small/blurred to confirm 'Repsol' branding; 'fairly used' condition cannot be judged from a single distant shot.

risks.risk: Valve/regulator seat condition and whether it holds gas without leaking
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short video of the valve, ideally with a regulator attached and a soapy-water leak test
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested/possibly leaking, i.e. needing valve service

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the embossed kg capacity stamp on the cylinder neck or body
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest common size for this cylinder type until capacity is confirmed

risks.risk: Cylinder re-certification/manufacture date, relevant to safety and legal refill eligibility
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped date/year on the cylinder collar
risks.if_unproven: priced as expired/unverified, i.e. may need re-certification before refill

risks.risk: Whether cylinder currently has any residual gas or is fully empty
risks.proof: Photo of a weighing scale reading with the cylinder, or seller statement with weight shown

risks.risk: Body condition - dents, rust, corrosion not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from top, bottom, and side angles in good light

proof_requests: Close-up, well-lit photo of the valve and any threading
Close-up photo of the embossed capacity (kg) and date stamp on the collar
Photo of the cylinder on a scale showing its weight
Additional photos from top, bottom, and side angles
Clear photo confirming the brand logo if 'Repsol' is to be claimed
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used LPG gas cylinder even though the brand logo is not legible, so it can be priced at worst case (empty, unverified valve/capacity/date) pending the listed proofs.
